backing.tranche_position_basis: Re equity absorbs first loss; reUSDe mezzanine absorbs second; reUSD senior absorbs last. Source: PegTracker reusde_re_backing.json loss_waterfall, 2026-09-03.
backing.eligible_sleeve_note: ⚠️ THIS IS A MANDATE, NOT A COMPOSITION. These are the assets the on-chain liquid sleeve is PERMITTED to hold. The MEASURED reserve is 98.97% sUSDe (see protocol_reserves_passthrough). T-Bills are an allowed rotation that HAS NOT OCCURRED. Reading the eligible set as the holding makes a single-asset book look diversified.
backing.backing_score_basis: ⚠️ AUTHORED, NOT COMPUTED — a FALLBACK that yields to any derived collateral ratio. Used because PegTracker DECLARES no ratio is establishable: Re's reserve dashboard combines reUSD and reUSDe and exposes no reUSDe-attributable denominator. reUSDe draws on the SAME capital pool as reUSD, so it carries the same 5.5. ⚠️ SUBORDINATION IS DELIBERATELY NOT PRICED HERE — reUSDe's junior position is carried on axis 1 (volatility 3.5) and axis 3 (redemption 2.0). Scoring seniority a second time here would double-count it. ⚠️ The measured book is 98.97% sUSDe, so 'good collateral' means one synthetic dollar carrying Ethena basis risk, not a diversified reserve; that concentration is priced on axis 4 (dependencies 4.0).
backing.backing_score_applies_when_note: ⚠️ MUST NOT fire on a merely-absent collateral_ratio. The producer DECLARES this one underivable in collateral_ratio_basis. A bare null can also mean a failed fetch or a feed outage — promoting an authored score over a measurement that exists but did not load is the failure where a failed read lands wherever the substitute sits. Require the DECLARATION, not the absence.
backing.no_attachment_point_note: ⚠️ NO attachment point is published for reUSDe, and reUSD's 9.66% MUST NOT be copied here. That figure is the SENIOR's — it measures the equity AND mezzanine sitting beneath reUSD. reUSDe has only Re's $20M first-loss equity beneath it, over a denominator the issuer does not attribute per-tranche. The senior's cushion is not the mezzanine's.
